rules: Setup: 15-minute opening-range breakout on 5-minute bars; enter on the first close above the range high, 09:30 to 14:30.
Stop at the opening-range midpoint; target 1R; out by 15:05 whatever happens.
Risk at most $150.00 a trade and $450.00 a day; at most 1 trade(s) a day; at most $11,250.00 in one stock.
Skip a stock: too dear for one share under that cap, a breakout under 0.15%, red-flag news (results, legal, a deal), or a Time Machine verdict of 'strongly toward the stop'.
Log every trading day: a trade, or a skip with its reason. No rule changes until the month ends.
